capabilities: Import highlights and notes from KOReader into Markdown files
Parse .sdr directories and Lua metadata files
Render notes from customizable templates with variables and conditionals
Extract book metadata and reading statistics
extras: Deeper templating documentation lives in an external wiki linked from the README.
problem: Highlights and notes stored in KOReader's Lua metadata files are not accessible in Obsidian, so reading annotations stay trapped on the device.

relations.evidence: This plugin imports highlights and notes from KOReader into Obsidian notes.

requires.name: KOReader on a mounted e-reader device

summary: Imports highlights and notes from the KOReader e-reader app by scanning .sdr directories and writing them into Markdown notes.
